<?php

/* Demand forecasting - shared functions.

 Sales history is extracted into forecasthistory from stockmoves (invoices type 10 and credit notes type 11,
 hidemovt = 0), exactly the movements InventoryPlanning.php and the other sales reports use.
 All the statistical methods work on a plain array of monthly quantities, oldest first.

 Library functions expect RAW (unescaped) values and escape what they put into SQL themselves. Pages must
 therefore look user selected ids up in the database first and hand over what the database returned,
 because $_POST has already been SQL escaped and HTML encoded by includes/session.php.
*/

define('FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE', 'FCST');

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ methods and parameters */

function ForecastMethods() {
	/* id => name, absolute minimum months of history and the parameters the method uses */
	return array(
		1 => array('name' => __('Percent over last year'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('GrowthPercent')),
		2 => array('name' => __('Calculated percent over last year'), 'min' => 24, 'params' => array()),
		3 => array('name' => __('Last year to this year'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array()),
		4 => array('name' => __('Moving average'), 'min' => 4, 'params' => array('MAPeriods')),
		5 => array('name' => __('Linear approximation'), 'min' => 6, 'params' => array('LinearBackPeriods')),
		6 => array('name' => __('Least squares regression'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array()),
		7 => array('name' => __('Second degree approximation'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array()),
		8 => array('name' => __('Flexible method'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('FlexibleWeights')),
		9 => array('name' => __('Weighted moving average'), 'min' => 4, 'params' => array('WMAWeights')),
		10 => array('name' => __('Simple exponential smoothing'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('Alpha')),
		11 => array('name' => __('Holt double exponential smoothing'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('Alpha', 'Beta')),
		12 => array('name' => __('Holt-Winters seasonal smoothing'), 'min' => 24, 'params' => array('Alpha', 'Beta', 'Gamma', 'SeasonLength'))
	);
}

function ForecastMethodName($MethodID) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	return isset($Methods[$MethodID]) ? $Methods[$MethodID]['name'] : __('Unknown');
}

function ForecastParameterDefaults() {
	return array(
		'Alpha' => '0.3',
		'Beta' => '0.1',
		'Gamma' => '0.1',
		'SeasonLength' => '12',
		'MAPeriods' => '4',
		'WMAWeights' => '0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1',
		'FlexibleWeights' => '0.25,0.2,0.15,0.1,0.05,0.05,0.05,0.05,0.025,0.025,0.025,0.025',
		'GrowthPercent' => '10',
		'LinearBackPeriods' => '5',
		'HoldoutMonths' => '3',
		'DefaultHorizon' => '12',
		'DefaultHistoryMonths' => '24',
		'LowAccuracyPOA' => '70',
		'VarianceHighlightPct' => '25'
	);
}

/* The company wide parameters: stored values over built in defaults */
function ForecastGetParameters() {
	$Parameters = ForecastParameterDefaults();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT paramname, paramvalue FROM forecastparameters");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if (isset($Parameters[$MyRow['paramname']])) {
			$Parameters[$MyRow['paramname']] = $MyRow['paramvalue'];
		}
	}
	return $Parameters;
}

function ForecastSetState($Name, $Value) {
	DB_query("REPLACE INTO forecastparameters (paramname, paramvalue) VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($Name) . "', '" . DB_escape_string($Value) . "')");
}

function ForecastGetState($Name) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT paramvalue FROM forecastparameters WHERE paramname = '" . DB_escape_string($Name) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? $MyRow[0] : null;
}

function ForecastParseWeights($Text) {
	$Weights = array();
	foreach (preg_split('/[\s,;\/]+/', trim($Text)) as $Piece) {
		if ($Piece === '') {
			continue;
		}
		if (!is_numeric($Piece) or $Piece < 0) {
			return false;
		}
		$Weights[] = (float) $Piece;
	}
	if (count($Weights) == 0 or array_sum($Weights) <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return $Weights;
}

/* Validate a set of parameters (names as in ForecastParameterDefaults). Returns array(clean values, error messages) */
function ForecastValidateParameters($Input) {
	$Clean = array();
	$Errors = array();
	foreach (array('Alpha' => array(0.1, 0.9), 'Beta' => array(0.01, 0.9), 'Gamma' => array(0.01, 0.9)) as $Name => $Range) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			if (!is_numeric($Input[$Name]) or $Input[$Name] < $Range[0] or $Input[$Name] > $Range[1]) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a number between %s and %s'), $Range[0], $Range[1]);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = (string) (float) $Input[$Name];
			}
		}
	}
	foreach (array('SeasonLength' => array(2, 24), 'MAPeriods' => array(2, 24), 'LinearBackPeriods' => array(2, 24), 'HoldoutMonths' => array(1, 12), 'DefaultHorizon' => array(1, 36), 'DefaultHistoryMonths' => array(12, 120)) as $Name => $Range) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			if (!is_numeric($Input[$Name]) or $Input[$Name] != (int) $Input[$Name] or $Input[$Name] < $Range[0] or $Input[$Name] > $Range[1]) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a whole number between %s and %s'), $Range[0], $Range[1]);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = (string) (int) $Input[$Name];
			}
		}
	}
	if (isset($Input['GrowthPercent'])) {
		if (!is_numeric($Input['GrowthPercent']) or $Input['GrowthPercent'] < -100 or $Input['GrowthPercent'] > 1000) {
			$Errors[] = 'GrowthPercent: ' . sprintf(__('must be a number between %s and %s'), -100, 1000);
		} else {
			$Clean['GrowthPercent'] = (string) (float) $Input['GrowthPercent'];
		}
	}
	foreach (array('LowAccuracyPOA' => array(0, 100), 'VarianceHighlightPct' => array(0, 1000)) as $Name => $Range) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			if (!is_numeric($Input[$Name]) or $Input[$Name] < $Range[0] or $Input[$Name] > $Range[1]) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a number between %s and %s'), $Range[0], $Range[1]);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = (string) (float) $Input[$Name];
			}
		}
	}
	foreach (array('WMAWeights' => 24, 'FlexibleWeights' => 12) as $Name => $MaxCount) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($Input[$Name]);
			if ($Weights === false or count($Weights) > $MaxCount) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a list of up to %s non negative numbers separated by commas'), $MaxCount);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = implode(',', $Weights);
			}
		}
	}
	return array($Clean, $Errors);
}

/* Parameters for a run: company defaults overridden by the fields the user filled in on the form.
   The form posts the parameters under their own names; blank means use the default. */
function ForecastResolveParameters($Posted) {
	$Overrides = array();
	foreach (array_keys(ForecastParameterDefaults()) as $Name) {
		if (isset($Posted[$Name]) and trim($Posted[$Name]) !== '') {
			$Overrides[$Name] = trim($Posted[$Name]);
		}
	}
	list($Clean, $Errors) = ForecastValidateParameters($Overrides);
	return array(array_merge(ForecastGetParameters(), $Clean), $Errors);
}

/* Only the parameters a method really uses, for recording with the forecast */
function ForecastMethodParameters($MethodID, $Parameters) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	$Used = array();
	foreach ($Methods[$MethodID]['params'] as $Name) {
		$Used[$Name] = $Parameters[$Name];
	}
	return $Used;
}

function ForecastMinHistory($MethodID, $P) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	$Min = $Methods[$MethodID]['min'];
	switch ($MethodID) {
		case 4:
			$Min = max($Min, (int) $P['MAPeriods']);
			break;
		case 5:
			$Min = max($Min, (int) $P['LinearBackPeriods'] + 1);
			break;
		case 8:
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($P['FlexibleWeights']);
			$Min = max($Min, $Weights ? count($Weights) : 12);
			break;
		case 9:
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($P['WMAWeights']);
			$Min = max($Min, $Weights ? count($Weights) : 4);
			break;
		case 12:
			$Min = max($Min, 2 * (int) $P['SeasonLength']);
			break;
	}
	return $Min;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ dates */

/* First day of the month of a Y-m-d date */
function ForecastMonthStart($Date) {
	return substr($Date, 0, 7) . '-01';
}

function ForecastAddMonths($Date, $Months) {
	$Total = (int) substr($Date, 0, 4) * 12 + (int) substr($Date, 5, 2) - 1 + $Months;
	return sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', floor($Total / 12), $Total % 12 + 1);
}

function ForecastMonthIndex($Date) {
	return (int) substr($Date, 0, 4) * 12 + (int) substr($Date, 5, 2) - 1;
}

function ForecastLastDayOfMonth($Date) {
	return date('Y-m-t', strtotime(ForecastMonthStart($Date)));
}

function ForecastIsDate($Date) {
	return is_string($Date) and preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/', $Date, $Parts) and checkdate((int) $Parts[2], (int) $Parts[3], (int) $Parts[1]);
}

/* Month of the last complete calendar month */
function ForecastLastCompleteMonth() {
	return ForecastAddMonths(date('Y-m-01'), -1);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ sales history */

/* The one definition of "sales": invoiced quantities (type 10) less credits (type 11), movements that are shown */
function ForecastSalesWhere() {
	return "stockmoves.type IN (10, 11) AND stockmoves.hidemovt = 0";
}

/* Range held in forecasthistory: array(from month, to month, extracted on, user) or null */
function ForecastHistoryRange() {
	$From = ForecastGetState('HistoryFrom');
	$To = ForecastGetState('HistoryTo');
	if ($From === null or $To === null) {
		return null;
	}
	return array('from' => $From, 'to' => $To, 'on' => ForecastGetState('HistoryExtractedOn'), 'user' => ForecastGetState('HistoryExtractedBy'));
}

/* Extract sales for the whole months From..To. Re-running a range replaces it. A range that neither overlaps nor
   touches the range already held replaces it (otherwise the gap would look like months without sales). */
function ForecastExtractHistory($From, $To, $UserID) {
	$From = ForecastMonthStart($From);
	$ToEnd = ForecastLastDayOfMonth($To);
	$Held = ForecastHistoryRange();

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	if ($Held !== null and ForecastMonthIndex($From) <= ForecastMonthIndex($Held['to']) + 1 and ForecastMonthIndex(ForecastMonthStart($To)) >= ForecastMonthIndex($Held['from']) - 1) {
		$NewFrom = min($From, $Held['from']);
		$NewTo = max(ForecastMonthStart($To), $Held['to']);
	} else {
		DB_query("DELETE FROM forecasthistory");
		$NewFrom = $From;
		$NewTo = ForecastMonthStart($To);
	}
	DB_query("DELETE FROM forecasthistory WHERE periodstart >= '" . $From . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToEnd . "'");
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO forecasthistory (stockid,
										loccode,
										debtortype,
										area,
										salesperson,
										periodstart,
										quantity)
			SELECT stockmoves.stockid,
					stockmoves.loccode,
					COALESCE(debtorsmaster.typeid, 0),
					COALESCE(custbranch.area, ''),
					COALESCE(custbranch.salesman, ''),
					DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01'),
					SUM(-stockmoves.qty)
			FROM stockmoves
			LEFT JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtorsmaster.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno
			LEFT JOIN custbranch ON custbranch.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno
				AND custbranch.branchcode = stockmoves.branchcode
			WHERE " . ForecastSalesWhere() . "
				AND stockmoves.trandate >= '" . $From . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate <= '" . $ToEnd . "'
			GROUP BY stockmoves.stockid,
					stockmoves.loccode,
					COALESCE(debtorsmaster.typeid, 0),
					COALESCE(custbranch.area, ''),
					COALESCE(custbranch.salesman, ''),
					DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01')
			HAVING SUM(-stockmoves.qty) <> 0";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The sales history could not be extracted'));
	$Inserted = DB_affected_rows();
	ForecastSetState('HistoryFrom', $NewFrom);
	ForecastSetState('HistoryTo', $NewTo);
	ForecastSetState('HistoryExtractedOn', date('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
	ForecastSetState('HistoryExtractedBy', $UserID);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return $Inserted;
}

function ForecastHistoryCounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stockid), COUNT(DISTINCT periodstart), COUNT(*) FROM forecasthistory");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return array('items' => (int) $MyRow[0], 'months' => (int) $MyRow[1], 'rows' => (int) $MyRow[2]);
}

/* Monthly history grouped by $GroupBy: stockid, category, debtortype, area or salesperson.
   $Filter keys: stockid, loccode (blank = all locations), categoryid, key. Returns array(group => array(month => qty)) */
function ForecastLoadHistory($GroupBy, $Filter = array()) {
	$Expressions = array('stockid' => 'forecasthistory.stockid',
						'category' => 'stockmaster.categoryid',
						'debtortype' => 'forecasthistory.debtortype',
						'area' => 'forecasthistory.area',
						'salesperson' => 'forecasthistory.salesperson');
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
	if ($Range === null) {
		return array();
	}
	$Where = "forecasthistory.periodstart >= '" . $Range['from'] . "' AND forecasthistory.periodstart <= '" . $Range['to'] . "'";
	if (isset($Filter['stockid'])) {
		$Where .= " AND forecasthistory.stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['stockid']) . "'";
	}
	if (isset($Filter['loccode']) and $Filter['loccode'] !== '') {
		$Where .= " AND forecasthistory.loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['loccode']) . "'";
	}
	if (isset($Filter['categoryid'])) {
		$Where .= " AND stockmaster.categoryid = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['categoryid']) . "'";
	}
	if (isset($Filter['key'])) {
		$Where .= " AND " . $Expressions[$GroupBy] . " = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['key']) . "'";
	}
	$SQL = "SELECT " . $Expressions[$GroupBy] . " AS grp,
					forecasthistory.periodstart,
					SUM(forecasthistory.quantity) AS qty
			FROM forecasthistory
			INNER JOIN stockmaster ON stockmaster.stockid = forecasthistory.stockid
			WHERE " . $Where . "
			GROUP BY grp, forecasthistory.periodstart";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$History = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$History[$MyRow['grp']][$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['qty'];
	}
	return $History;
}

/* Turn sparse month => quantity into a series running from the first month with sales to the end of the history
   range. Months without sales inside it are zero. Months before the first sale are not history. Negative net
   months (more credits than sales) are taken as zero demand.
   Returns array('values' => array, 'start' => first month) */
function ForecastBuildSeries($ByMonth) {
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
	if ($Range === null or count($ByMonth) == 0) {
		return array('values' => array(), 'start' => null);
	}
	ksort($ByMonth);
	$Start = null;
	foreach ($ByMonth as $Month => $Qty) {
		if ($Qty != 0) {
			$Start = $Month;
			break;
		}
	}
	if ($Start === null) {
		return array('values' => array(), 'start' => null);
	}
	$Values = array();
	for ($Month = $Start; ForecastMonthIndex($Month) <= ForecastMonthIndex($Range['to']); $Month = ForecastAddMonths($Month, 1)) {
		$Values[] = isset($ByMonth[$Month]) ? max(0, $ByMonth[$Month]) : 0;
	}
	return array('values' => $Values, 'start' => $Start);
}

/* Actual sales by month for one item (blank location = all) read straight from the stock movements */
function ForecastActualsByMonth($StockID, $LocCode, $FromMonth, $ToMonth) {
	$SQL = "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01') AS periodstart,
					SUM(-stockmoves.qty) AS qty
			FROM stockmoves
			WHERE " . ForecastSalesWhere() . "
				AND stockmoves.stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($StockID) . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate >= '" . ForecastMonthStart($FromMonth) . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate <= '" . ForecastLastDayOfMonth($ToMonth) . "'";
	if ($LocCode !== '') {
		$SQL .= " AND stockmoves.loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($LocCode) . "'";
	}
	$SQL .= " GROUP BY periodstart";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Actuals = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Actuals[$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['qty'];
	}
	return $Actuals;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the methods */

/* Solve a small linear system by Gaussian elimination; false if singular */
function ForecastSolve($A, $B) {
	$N = count($B);
	for ($i = 0; $i < $N; $i++) {
		$Pivot = $i;
		for ($r = $i + 1; $r < $N; $r++) {
			if (abs($A[$r][$i]) > abs($A[$Pivot][$i])) {
				$Pivot = $r;
			}
		}
		if (abs($A[$Pivot][$i]) < 1e-12) {
			return false;
		}
		list($A[$i], $A[$Pivot]) = array($A[$Pivot], $A[$i]);
		list($B[$i], $B[$Pivot]) = array($B[$Pivot], $B[$i]);
		for ($r = $i + 1; $r < $N; $r++) {
			$Factor = $A[$r][$i] / $A[$i][$i];
			for ($c = $i; $c < $N; $c++) {
				$A[$r][$c] -= $Factor * $A[$i][$c];
			}
			$B[$r] -= $Factor * $B[$i];
		}
	}
	$X = array_fill(0, $N, 0);
	for ($i = $N - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
		$Sum = $B[$i];
		for ($c = $i + 1; $c < $N; $c++) {
			$Sum -= $A[$i][$c] * $X[$c];
		}
		$X[$i] = $Sum / $A[$i][$i];
	}
	return $X;
}

/* Forecast $Horizon months after the end of the series $y (oldest first) with method $MethodID.
   Returns array('ok' => bool, 'values' => forecast quantities (never negative), 'error' => reason) */
function ForecastRunMethod($MethodID, $y, $Horizon, $P) {
	$n = count($y);
	$Min = ForecastMinHistory($MethodID, $P);
	if ($n < $Min) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => sprintf(__('%s needs at least %s months of sales history but only %s are available'), ForecastMethodName($MethodID), $Min, $n));
	}
	$f = array();
	switch ($MethodID) {
		case 1: // last year x (1 + p/100)
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)] * (1 + $P['GrowthPercent'] / 100);
			}
			break;
		case 2: // growth of the last 12 months on the 12 before
			$Last = array_sum(array_slice($y, -12));
			$Prior = array_sum(array_slice($y, -24, 12));
			if ($Prior <= 0) {
				return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => __('There were no sales in the year before last so a growth percent cannot be calculated'));
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)] * $Last / $Prior;
			}
			break;
		case 3: // same month last year
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)];
			}
			break;
		case 4: // moving average of the last N periods, rolled forward on its own results
			$N = (int) $P['MAPeriods'];
			$Work = $y;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Value = array_sum(array_slice($Work, -$N)) / $N;
				$Work[] = $Value;
				$f[] = $Value;
			}
			break;
		case 5: // straight line through the last point and the point K periods before it
			$K = (int) $P['LinearBackPeriods'];
			$Slope = ($y[$n - 1] - $y[$n - 1 - $K]) / $K;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 1] + $Slope * $h;
			}
			break;
		case 6: // least squares line through all the history
			$SumX = $SumY = $SumXY = $SumXX = 0;
			for ($x = 0; $x < $n; $x++) {
				$SumX += $x;
				$SumY += $y[$x];
				$SumXY += $x * $y[$x];
				$SumXX += $x * $x;
			}
			$B = ($n * $SumXY - $SumX * $SumY) / ($n * $SumXX - $SumX * $SumX);
			$A = ($SumY - $B * $SumX) / $n;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $A + $B * ($n - 1 + $h);
			}
			break;
		case 7: // least squares parabola, x centred for numerical stability
			$Mean = ($n - 1) / 2;
			$S = array_fill(0, 5, 0);
			$T = array_fill(0, 3, 0);
			for ($x = 0; $x < $n; $x++) {
				$Xc = $x - $Mean;
				for ($p = 0; $p <= 4; $p++) {
					$S[$p] += pow($Xc, $p);
				}
				for ($p = 0; $p <= 2; $p++) {
					$T[$p] += pow($Xc, $p) * $y[$x];
				}
			}
			$Coefficients = ForecastSolve(array(array($S[0], $S[1], $S[2]), array($S[1], $S[2], $S[3]), array($S[2], $S[3], $S[4])), $T);
			if ($Coefficients === false) {
				return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => __('The second degree curve could not be fitted to the history'));
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Xc = $n - 1 + $h - $Mean;
				$f[] = $Coefficients[0] + $Coefficients[1] * $Xc + $Coefficients[2] * $Xc * $Xc;
			}
			break;
		case 8: // user weights per prior period, as entered
		case 9: // weighted moving average, weights scaled to add up to one
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($P[$MethodID == 8 ? 'FlexibleWeights' : 'WMAWeights']);
			if ($MethodID == 9) {
				$Total = array_sum($Weights);
				foreach ($Weights as $Key => $Weight) {
					$Weights[$Key] = $Weight / $Total;
				}
			}
			$Work = $y;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Value = 0;
				foreach ($Weights as $Lag => $Weight) {
					$Value += $Weight * $Work[count($Work) - 1 - $Lag];
				}
				$Work[] = $Value;
				$f[] = $Value;
			}
			break;
		case 10: // simple exponential smoothing
			$Alpha = (float) $P['Alpha'];
			$Level = $y[0];
			for ($t = 1; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Level = $Alpha * $y[$t] + (1 - $Alpha) * $Level;
			}
			$f = array_fill(0, $Horizon, $Level);
			break;
		case 11: // Holt double exponential smoothing
			$Alpha = (float) $P['Alpha'];
			$Beta = (float) $P['Beta'];
			$Level = $y[0];
			$Trend = $y[1] - $y[0];
			for ($t = 1; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Previous = $Level;
				$Level = $Alpha * $y[$t] + (1 - $Alpha) * ($Level + $Trend);
				$Trend = $Beta * ($Level - $Previous) + (1 - $Beta) * $Trend;
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $Level + $h * $Trend;
			}
			break;
		case 12: // Holt-Winters, additive seasonality
			$Alpha = (float) $P['Alpha'];
			$Beta = (float) $P['Beta'];
			$Gamma = (float) $P['Gamma'];
			$L = (int) $P['SeasonLength'];
			$Mean1 = array_sum(array_slice($y, 0, $L)) / $L;
			$Mean2 = array_sum(array_slice($y, $L, $L)) / $L;
			$Trend = ($Mean2 - $Mean1) / $L;
			$Level = $Mean1 + $Trend * ($L - 1) / 2; // level at the end of the first season
			$Season = array();
			for ($i = 0; $i < $L; $i++) {
				$Season[$i] = $y[$i] - ($Mean1 + $Trend * ($i - ($L - 1) / 2));
			}
			for ($t = $L; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Previous = $Level;
				$Level = $Alpha * ($y[$t] - $Season[$t % $L]) + (1 - $Alpha) * ($Level + $Trend);
				$Trend = $Beta * ($Level - $Previous) + (1 - $Beta) * $Trend;
				$Season[$t % $L] = $Gamma * ($y[$t] - $Level) + (1 - $Gamma) * $Season[$t % $L];
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $Level + $h * $Trend + $Season[($n - 1 + $h) % $L];
			}
			break;
	}
	foreach ($f as $Key => $Value) {
		if (!is_finite($Value)) {
			return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => __('The method did not produce a usable result for this history'));
		}
		$f[$Key] = max(0, round($Value, 4));
	}
	return array('ok' => true, 'values' => $f, 'error' => '');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ accuracy and best fit */

/* $Pairs = list of array(actual, forecast). MAD, POA (percent of accuracy), MSE, RMSE */
function ForecastStats($Pairs) {
	$Count = count($Pairs);
	$Actual = $Abs = $Sq = 0;
	foreach ($Pairs as $Pair) {
		$Error = $Pair[0] - $Pair[1];
		$Actual += $Pair[0];
		$Abs += abs($Error);
		$Sq += $Error * $Error;
	}
	if ($Count == 0) {
		return array('n' => 0, 'actual' => 0, 'abs' => 0, 'mad' => null, 'poa' => null, 'mse' => null, 'rmse' => null);
	}
	/* POA = 100 x (1 - total absolute error / total actual), not below zero. With no actual sales it is
	   100 only when nothing was forecast either. */
	if ($Actual > 0) {
		$POA = max(0, 100 * (1 - $Abs / $Actual));
	} else {
		$POA = $Abs == 0 ? 100 : 0;
	}
	return array('n' => $Count, 'actual' => $Actual, 'abs' => $Abs, 'mad' => $Abs / $Count, 'poa' => $POA, 'mse' => $Sq / $Count, 'rmse' => sqrt($Sq / $Count));
}

/* Hold out the last $Holdout months of $y, forecast them with every method that has enough history
   left and score them. Returns array(method id => array('ok', 'error', 'forecast', 'actual', 'stats')) */
function ForecastEvaluateMethods($y, $Holdout, $P) {
	$n = count($y);
	$Results = array();
	foreach (array_keys(ForecastMethods()) as $MethodID) {
		if ($Holdout >= $n) {
			$Results[$MethodID] = array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('Not enough history to hold months out'), 'forecast' => array(), 'actual' => array(), 'stats' => null);
			continue;
		}
		$Train = array_slice($y, 0, $n - $Holdout);
		$Actual = array_slice($y, $n - $Holdout);
		$Run = ForecastRunMethod($MethodID, $Train, $Holdout, $P);
		$Results[$MethodID] = array('ok' => $Run['ok'],
									'error' => $Run['error'],
									'forecast' => $Run['values'],
									'actual' => $Actual,
									'stats' => null);
		if ($Run['ok']) {
			$Pairs = array();
			foreach ($Actual as $Key => $Value) {
				$Pairs[] = array($Value, $Run['values'][$Key]);
			}
			$Results[$MethodID]['stats'] = ForecastStats($Pairs);
		}
	}
	return $Results;
}

/* Best fit for one series: method with the lowest total absolute error on the held out months (lowest id on a tie).
   Returns array(method id or 0, evaluation) */
function ForecastBestMethod($y, $Holdout, $P) {
	$Evaluation = ForecastEvaluateMethods($y, $Holdout, $P);
	$Best = 0;
	foreach ($Evaluation as $MethodID => $Result) {
		if ($Result['ok'] and ($Best == 0 or $Result['stats']['abs'] < $Evaluation[$Best]['stats']['abs'] - 1e-9)) {
			$Best = $MethodID;
		}
	}
	return array($Best, $Evaluation);
}

/* Best fit across many items: the method with the lowest total absolute error as a share of total actual sales
   on the held out months. A method must be applicable to at least half of the items that could be evaluated at all.
   $SeriesList = array(key => array of values). Returns array(best method id or 0, array(method id => array(items, abs, actual, score))) */
function ForecastBestMethodForSet($SeriesList, $Holdout, $P) {
	$Totals = array();
	foreach (array_keys(ForecastMethods()) as $MethodID) {
		$Totals[$MethodID] = array('items' => 0, 'abs' => 0, 'actual' => 0, 'score' => null);
	}
	$Evaluated = 0;
	foreach ($SeriesList as $y) {
		$Any = false;
		foreach (ForecastEvaluateMethods($y, $Holdout, $P) as $MethodID => $Result) {
			if ($Result['ok']) {
				$Any = true;
				$Totals[$MethodID]['items']++;
				$Totals[$MethodID]['abs'] += $Result['stats']['abs'];
				$Totals[$MethodID]['actual'] += $Result['stats']['actual'];
			}
		}
		if ($Any) {
			$Evaluated++;
		}
	}
	$Best = 0;
	foreach ($Totals as $MethodID => $Total) {
		if ($Total['items'] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$Totals[$MethodID]['score'] = $Total['actual'] > 0 ? $Total['abs'] / $Total['actual'] : ($Total['abs'] > 0 ? PHP_INT_MAX : 0);
		if ($Total['items'] * 2 >= $Evaluated and ($Best == 0 or $Totals[$MethodID]['score'] < $Totals[$Best]['score'] - 1e-12)) {
			$Best = $MethodID;
		}
	}
	return array($Best, $Totals);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ storing forecasts */

/* Store a forecast for an item (blank location = all locations combined) and make it the active one; the
   previous active forecast is superseded but kept. Returns the new forecast id. */
function ForecastStoreItemForecast($StockID, $LocCode, $MethodID, $Parameters, $Series, $Values, $UserID) {
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
	$StockID = DB_escape_string($StockID);
	$LocCode = DB_escape_string($LocCode);
	DB_Txn_Begin();
	DB_query("UPDATE forecasts SET active = NULL, supersededon = NOW()
				WHERE stockid = '" . $StockID . "' AND loccode = '" . $LocCode . "' AND active = 1");
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO forecasts (stockid,
									loccode,
									methodid,
									parameters,
									horizon,
									historyfrom,
									historyto,
									historymonths,
									generatedon,
									generatedby,
									active)
			VALUES ('" . $StockID . "',
					'" . $LocCode . "',
					" . (int) $MethodID . ",
					'" . DB_escape_string(json_encode(ForecastMethodParameters($MethodID, $Parameters))) . "',
					" . count($Values) . ",
					'" . $Range['from'] . "',
					'" . $Range['to'] . "',
					" . count($Series['values']) . ",
					NOW(),
					'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
					1)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The forecast could not be saved'));
	$ForecastID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('forecasts', 'forecastid');
	$Period = ForecastAddMonths($Range['to'], 1);
	foreach ($Values as $Value) {
		DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastdetails (forecastid, periodstart, calcqty) VALUES (" . (int) $ForecastID . ", '" . $Period . "', '" . $Value . "')");
		$Period = ForecastAddMonths($Period, 1);
	}
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return $ForecastID;
}

/* Same for a summary forecast: $Dimension is category, debtortype, area or salesperson */
function ForecastStoreSummaryForecast($Dimension, $Key, $MethodID, $Parameters, $Series, $Values, $UserID) {
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();

											dimkey,
											methodid,
											parameters,
											horizon,
											historyfrom,
											historyto,
											historymonths,

/* Forecast one item/location from the extracted history. $MethodID 0 = best fit for this item.
   Returns array('ok', 'error', 'method', 'forecastid') */
function ForecastGenerateForItem($StockID, $LocCode, $MethodID, $Horizon, $P, $UserID, $History = null) {
	if (ForecastHistoryRange() === null) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('There is no sales history - extract it first'), 'method' => $MethodID, 'forecastid' => 0);
	}
	if ($History === null) {
		$History = ForecastLoadHistory('stockid', array('stockid' => $StockID, 'loccode' => $LocCode));
	}
	$Series = ForecastBuildSeries(isset($History[$StockID]) ? $History[$StockID] : array());
	if (count($Series['values']) == 0) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('No sales in the history for this item'), 'method' => $MethodID, 'forecastid' => 0);
	}
	if ($MethodID == 0) {
		list($MethodID, $Evaluation) = ForecastBestMethod($Series['values'], (int) $P['HoldoutMonths'], $P);
		if ($MethodID == 0) {
			return array('ok' => false, 'error' => sprintf(__('Only %s months of sales history - too short for any method once %s months are held out'), count($Series['values']), $P['HoldoutMonths']), 'method' => 0, 'forecastid' => 0);
		}
	}
	$Run = ForecastRunMethod($MethodID, $Series['values'], $Horizon, $P);
	if (!$Run['ok']) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'error' => $Run['error'], 'method' => $MethodID, 'forecastid' => 0);
	}
	$ForecastID = ForecastStoreItemForecast($StockID, $LocCode, $MethodID, $P, $Series, $Run['values'], $UserID);
	return array('ok' => true, 'error' => '', 'method' => $MethodID, 'forecastid' => $ForecastID);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ batches */

/* Create a generation job for one item or all the active items of a category and, for best fit on a category,
   decide the method for the whole category. Returns array(batch id, best fit table or null) */
function ForecastCreateBatch($Scope, $StockID, $CategoryID, $LocCode, $MethodID, $Horizon, $P, $UserID) {
	$Items = array();
	if ($Scope == 'item') {
		$Items[] = $StockID;
	} else {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT stockid FROM stockmaster
							WHERE categoryid = '" . DB_escape_string($CategoryID) . "' AND discontinued = 0
							ORDER BY stockid");
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
			$Items[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	$Chosen = $MethodID;
	$BestFit = null;
	if ($MethodID == 0 and $Scope == 'category') {
		$Histories = ForecastLoadHistory('stockid', array('categoryid' => $CategoryID, 'loccode' => $LocCode));
		$SeriesList = array();
		foreach ($Histories as $ItemID => $ByMonth) {
			$Series = ForecastBuildSeries($ByMonth);
			if (count($Series['values']) > 0) {
				$SeriesList[$ItemID] = $Series['values'];
			}
		}
		list($Chosen, $BestFit) = ForecastBestMethodForSet($SeriesList, (int) $P['HoldoutMonths'], $P);
	}
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO forecastbatches (userid,
										createdon,
										scope,
										stockid,
										categoryid,
										loccode,
										methodid,
										chosenmethod,
										parameters,
										horizon,
										status,
										total)
			VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $Scope . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($StockID) . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($CategoryID) . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($LocCode) . "',
					" . (int) $MethodID . ",
					" . (int) $Chosen . ",
					'" . DB_escape_string(json_encode($P)) . "',
					" . (int) $Horizon . ",
					'running',
					" . count($Items) . ")";
	DB_Txn_Begin();
	DB_query($SQL, __('The forecast batch could not be created'));
	$BatchID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('forecastbatches', 'batchid');
	foreach ($Items as $ItemID) {
		DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastbatchresults (batchid, stockid, status) VALUES (" . (int) $BatchID . ", '" . DB_escape_string($ItemID) . "', 'pending')");
	}
	if (count($Items) == 0) {
		DB_query("UPDATE forecastbatches SET status = 'complete' WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
	}
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return array($BatchID, $BestFit);
}

/* Process up to $ChunkSize pending items of a batch. Returns the batch row (fresh counts) or null if unknown */
function ForecastProcessBatch($BatchID, $ChunkSize = 25) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM forecastbatches WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
	$Batch = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (!$Batch) {
		return null;
	}
	if ($Batch['status'] == 'running') {
		$P = json_decode($Batch['parameters'], true);
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT stockid FROM forecastbatchresults
							WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND status = 'pending'
							ORDER BY stockid LIMIT " . (int) $ChunkSize);
		$Items = array();
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
			$Items[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
		/* history of the whole chunk in one query */
		$Histories = array();
		if (count($Items) > 0 and ForecastHistoryRange() !== null) {
			$Quoted = array();
			foreach ($Items as $ItemID) {
				$Quoted[] = "'" . DB_escape_string($ItemID) . "'";
			}
			$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
			$SQL = "SELECT stockid, periodstart, SUM(quantity) AS qty
					FROM forecasthistory
					WHERE stockid IN (" . implode(',', $Quoted) . ")
						AND periodstart >= '" . $Range['from'] . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $Range['to'] . "'" .
						($Batch['loccode'] !== '' ? " AND loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($Batch['loccode']) . "'" : '') . "
					GROUP BY stockid, periodstart";
			$HistoryResult = DB_query($SQL);
			while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($HistoryResult)) {
				$Histories[$MyRow['stockid']][$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['qty'];
			}
		}
		/* a single item with best fit (method 0) picks its own method; a category was decided when the batch was created */
		$MethodID = $Batch['scope'] == 'item' ? (int) $Batch['methodid'] : (int) $Batch['chosenmethod'];
		foreach ($Items as $ItemID) {
			if ($Batch['scope'] == 'category' and $MethodID == 0) {
				$Run = array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('No method could be recommended for this category'), 'method' => 0, 'forecastid' => 0);
			} else {
				$Run = ForecastGenerateForItem($ItemID, $Batch['loccode'], $MethodID, (int) $Batch['horizon'], $P, $Batch['userid'], array($ItemID => isset($Histories[$ItemID]) ? $Histories[$ItemID] : array()));
			}
			DB_query("UPDATE forecastbatchresults SET status = '" . ($Run['ok'] ? 'success' : 'failed') . "',
							methodid = " . (int) $Run['method'] . ",
							forecastid = " . (int) $Run['forecastid'] . ",
							message = '" . DB_escape_string($Run['error']) . "'
						WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($ItemID) . "'");
		}
		$SQL = "UPDATE forecastbatches SET success = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forecastbatchresults WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND status = 'success'),
					failed = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forecastbatchresults WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND status = 'failed')
				WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID;
		DB_query($SQL);
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forecastbatchresults WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID . " AND status = 'pending'");
		$Pending = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		if ($Pending[0] == 0) {
			DB_query("UPDATE forecastbatches SET status = 'complete' WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM forecastbatches WHERE batchid = " . (int) $BatchID);
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ active forecasts, MRP */

/* Quantities of the active item forecasts, revised quantity first, between two months:
   array(stockid => array(month => qty)). Where an item has a forecast for all locations combined it is used,
   otherwise the active location forecasts are added together, so nothing is counted twice.
   $StockFilterSQL is a SQL condition on forecasts.stockid built by the caller from safe values. */
function ForecastActiveItemQuantities($StockFilterSQL, $FromMonth, $ToMonth) {
	$SQL = "SELECT forecasts.stockid,
					forecasts.loccode,
					forecastdetails.periodstart,
					COALESCE(forecastdetails.revisedqty, forecastdetails.calcqty) AS qty
			FROM forecasts
			INNER JOIN forecastdetails ON forecastdetails.forecastid = forecasts.forecastid
			WHERE forecasts.active = 1
				AND forecastdetails.periodstart >= '" . ForecastMonthStart($FromMonth) . "'
				AND forecastdetails.periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'
				AND " . $StockFilterSQL;
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Rows = array();
	$Combined = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Kind = $MyRow['loccode'] === '' ? 'ALL' : 'LOC';
		if (!isset($Rows[$MyRow['stockid']][$Kind][$MyRow['periodstart']])) {
			$Rows[$MyRow['stockid']][$Kind][$MyRow['periodstart']] = 0;
		}
		$Rows[$MyRow['stockid']][$Kind][$MyRow['periodstart']] += (float) $MyRow['qty'];
	}
	foreach ($Rows as $StockID => $Kinds) {
		$Combined[$StockID] = isset($Kinds['ALL']) ? $Kinds['ALL'] : $Kinds['LOC'];
		ksort($Combined[$StockID]);
	}
	return $Combined;
}

function ForecastEnsureDemandType() {
	DB_query("INSERT IGNORE INTO mrpdemandtypes (mrpdemandtype, description) VALUES ('" . FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE . "', '" . DB_escape_string(__('Statistical Forecast')) . "')");
}

/* Convert the active forecasts of the items matched by $StockFilterSQL into MRP demands (demand type FCST) for the
   months From..To. Demands created here are recorded in forecastmrpdemands, so replace mode only ever removes
   those and demands entered by hand (even under the same demand type) are never touched.
   $Mode: replace or incremental. Returns array(items, created, removed, skipped) */
function ForecastConvertToMRP($StockFilterSQL, $FromMonth, $ToMonth, $Mode) {
	ForecastEnsureDemandType();
	$FromMonth = ForecastMonthStart($FromMonth);
	$ToMonth = ForecastMonthStart($ToMonth);
	$Quantities = ForecastActiveItemQuantities($StockFilterSQL, $FromMonth, $ToMonth);
	$Created = $Removed = $Skipped = 0;

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	/* tracking rows whose demand has been deleted elsewhere (MRPDemands.php) are stale */
	DB_query("DELETE forecastmrpdemands FROM forecastmrpdemands
				LEFT JOIN mrpdemands ON mrpdemands.demandid = forecastmrpdemands.demandid
				WHERE mrpdemands.demandid IS NULL");
	foreach ($Quantities as $StockID => $ByMonth) {
		$Escaped = DB_escape_string($StockID);
		$Present = array();
		if ($Mode == 'replace') {
			DB_query("DELETE mrpdemands FROM mrpdemands
						INNER JOIN forecastmrpdemands ON forecastmrpdemands.demandid = mrpdemands.demandid
						WHERE forecastmrpdemands.stockid = '" . $Escaped . "'
							AND forecastmrpdemands.periodstart >= '" . $FromMonth . "'
							AND forecastmrpdemands.periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'");
			$Removed += DB_affected_rows();
			DB_query("DELETE FROM forecastmrpdemands
						WHERE stockid = '" . $Escaped . "'
							AND periodstart >= '" . $FromMonth . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'");
		} else {
			$Result = DB_query("SELECT periodstart FROM forecastmrpdemands
								WHERE stockid = '" . $Escaped . "'
									AND periodstart >= '" . $FromMonth . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToMonth . "'");
			while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
				$Present[$MyRow[0]] = true;
			}
		}
		foreach ($ByMonth as $Month => $Qty) {
			if (isset($Present[$Month])) {
				$Skipped++;
				continue;
			}
			if ($Qty <= 0) {
				continue;
			}
			DB_query("INSERT INTO mrpdemands (stockid, mrpdemandtype, quantity, duedate)
						VALUES ('" . $Escaped . "', '" . FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE . "', '" . $Qty . "', '" . $Month . "')");
			$DemandID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('mrpdemands', 'demandid');
			DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastmrpdemands (demandid, stockid, periodstart) VALUES (" . (int) $DemandID . ", '" . $Escaped . "', '" . $Month . "')");
			$Created++;
		}
	}
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return array('items' => count($Quantities), 'created' => $Created, 'removed' => $Removed, 'skipped' => $Skipped);
}

<?php

/* Demand forecasting - shared functions.

 Sales history is extracted into forecasthistory from stockmoves (invoices type 10 and credit notes type 11,
 hidemovt = 0), exactly the movements InventoryPlanning.php and the other sales reports use.
 All the statistical methods work on a plain array of monthly quantities, oldest first.

 Library functions expect RAW (unescaped) values and escape what they put into SQL themselves. Pages must
 therefore look user selected ids up in the database first and hand over what the database returned,
 because $_POST has already been SQL escaped and HTML encoded by includes/session.php.
*/

define('FORECAST_DEMAND_TYPE', 'FCST');

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ methods and parameters */

function ForecastMethods() {
	/* id => name, absolute minimum months of history and the parameters the method uses */
	return array(
		1 => array('name' => __('Percent over last year'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('GrowthPercent')),
		2 => array('name' => __('Calculated percent over last year'), 'min' => 24, 'params' => array()),
		3 => array('name' => __('Last year to this year'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array()),
		4 => array('name' => __('Moving average'), 'min' => 4, 'params' => array('MAPeriods')),
		5 => array('name' => __('Linear approximation'), 'min' => 6, 'params' => array('LinearBackPeriods')),
		6 => array('name' => __('Least squares regression'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array()),
		7 => array('name' => __('Second degree approximation'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array()),
		8 => array('name' => __('Flexible method'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('FlexibleWeights')),
		9 => array('name' => __('Weighted moving average'), 'min' => 4, 'params' => array('WMAWeights')),
		10 => array('name' => __('Simple exponential smoothing'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('Alpha')),
		11 => array('name' => __('Holt double exponential smoothing'), 'min' => 12, 'params' => array('Alpha', 'Beta')),
		12 => array('name' => __('Holt-Winters seasonal smoothing'), 'min' => 24, 'params' => array('Alpha', 'Beta', 'Gamma', 'SeasonLength'))
	);
}

function ForecastMethodName($MethodID) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	return isset($Methods[$MethodID]) ? $Methods[$MethodID]['name'] : __('Unknown');
}

function ForecastParameterDefaults() {
	return array(
		'Alpha' => '0.3',
		'Beta' => '0.1',
		'Gamma' => '0.1',
		'SeasonLength' => '12',
		'MAPeriods' => '4',
		'WMAWeights' => '0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1',
		'FlexibleWeights' => '0.25,0.2,0.15,0.1,0.05,0.05,0.05,0.05,0.025,0.025,0.025,0.025',
		'GrowthPercent' => '10',
		'LinearBackPeriods' => '5',
		'HoldoutMonths' => '3',
		'DefaultHorizon' => '12',
		'DefaultHistoryMonths' => '24',
		'LowAccuracyPOA' => '70',
		'VarianceHighlightPct' => '25'
	);
}

/* The company wide parameters: stored values over built in defaults */
function ForecastGetParameters() {
	$Parameters = ForecastParameterDefaults();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT paramname, paramvalue FROM forecastparameters");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if (isset($Parameters[$MyRow['paramname']])) {
			$Parameters[$MyRow['paramname']] = $MyRow['paramvalue'];
		}
	}
	return $Parameters;
}

function ForecastSetState($Name, $Value) {
	DB_query("REPLACE INTO forecastparameters (paramname, paramvalue) VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($Name) . "', '" . DB_escape_string($Value) . "')");
}

function ForecastGetState($Name) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT paramvalue FROM forecastparameters WHERE paramname = '" . DB_escape_string($Name) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? $MyRow[0] : null;
}

function ForecastParseWeights($Text) {
	$Weights = array();
	foreach (preg_split('/[\s,;\/]+/', trim($Text)) as $Piece) {
		if ($Piece === '') {
			continue;
		}
		if (!is_numeric($Piece) or $Piece < 0) {
			return false;
		}
		$Weights[] = (float) $Piece;
	}
	if (count($Weights) == 0 or array_sum($Weights) <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return $Weights;
}

/* Validate a set of parameters (names as in ForecastParameterDefaults). Returns array(clean values, error messages) */
function ForecastValidateParameters($Input) {
	$Clean = array();
	$Errors = array();
	foreach (array('Alpha' => array(0.1, 0.9), 'Beta' => array(0.01, 0.9), 'Gamma' => array(0.01, 0.9)) as $Name => $Range) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			if (!is_numeric($Input[$Name]) or $Input[$Name] < $Range[0] or $Input[$Name] > $Range[1]) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a number between %s and %s'), $Range[0], $Range[1]);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = (string) (float) $Input[$Name];
			}
		}
	}
	foreach (array('SeasonLength' => array(2, 24), 'MAPeriods' => array(2, 24), 'LinearBackPeriods' => array(2, 24), 'HoldoutMonths' => array(1, 12), 'DefaultHorizon' => array(1, 36), 'DefaultHistoryMonths' => array(12, 120)) as $Name => $Range) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			if (!is_numeric($Input[$Name]) or $Input[$Name] != (int) $Input[$Name] or $Input[$Name] < $Range[0] or $Input[$Name] > $Range[1]) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a whole number between %s and %s'), $Range[0], $Range[1]);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = (string) (int) $Input[$Name];
			}
		}
	}
	if (isset($Input['GrowthPercent'])) {
		if (!is_numeric($Input['GrowthPercent']) or $Input['GrowthPercent'] < -100 or $Input['GrowthPercent'] > 1000) {
			$Errors[] = 'GrowthPercent: ' . sprintf(__('must be a number between %s and %s'), -100, 1000);
		} else {
			$Clean['GrowthPercent'] = (string) (float) $Input['GrowthPercent'];
		}
	}
	foreach (array('LowAccuracyPOA' => array(0, 100), 'VarianceHighlightPct' => array(0, 1000)) as $Name => $Range) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			if (!is_numeric($Input[$Name]) or $Input[$Name] < $Range[0] or $Input[$Name] > $Range[1]) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a number between %s and %s'), $Range[0], $Range[1]);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = (string) (float) $Input[$Name];
			}
		}
	}
	foreach (array('WMAWeights' => 24, 'FlexibleWeights' => 12) as $Name => $MaxCount) {
		if (isset($Input[$Name])) {
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($Input[$Name]);
			if ($Weights === false or count($Weights) > $MaxCount) {
				$Errors[] = $Name . ': ' . sprintf(__('must be a list of up to %s non negative numbers separated by commas'), $MaxCount);
			} else {
				$Clean[$Name] = implode(',', $Weights);
			}
		}
	}
	return array($Clean, $Errors);
}

/* Parameters for a run: company defaults overridden by the fields the user filled in on the form.
   The form posts the parameters under their own names; blank means use the default. */
function ForecastResolveParameters($Posted) {
	$Overrides = array();
	foreach (array_keys(ForecastParameterDefaults()) as $Name) {
		if (isset($Posted[$Name]) and trim($Posted[$Name]) !== '') {
			$Overrides[$Name] = trim($Posted[$Name]);
		}
	}
	list($Clean, $Errors) = ForecastValidateParameters($Overrides);
	return array(array_merge(ForecastGetParameters(), $Clean), $Errors);
}

/* Only the parameters a method really uses, for recording with the forecast */
function ForecastMethodParameters($MethodID, $Parameters) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	$Used = array();
	foreach ($Methods[$MethodID]['params'] as $Name) {
		$Used[$Name] = $Parameters[$Name];
	}
	return $Used;
}

function ForecastMinHistory($MethodID, $P) {
	$Methods = ForecastMethods();
	$Min = $Methods[$MethodID]['min'];
	switch ($MethodID) {
		case 4:
			$Min = max($Min, (int) $P['MAPeriods']);
			break;
		case 5:
			$Min = max($Min, (int) $P['LinearBackPeriods'] + 1);
			break;
		case 8:
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($P['FlexibleWeights']);
			$Min = max($Min, $Weights ? count($Weights) : 12);
			break;
		case 9:
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($P['WMAWeights']);
			$Min = max($Min, $Weights ? count($Weights) : 4);
			break;
		case 12:
			$Min = max($Min, 2 * (int) $P['SeasonLength']);
			break;
	}
	return $Min;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ dates */

/* First day of the month of a Y-m-d date */
function ForecastMonthStart($Date) {
	return substr($Date, 0, 7) . '-01';
}

function ForecastAddMonths($Date, $Months) {
	$Total = (int) substr($Date, 0, 4) * 12 + (int) substr($Date, 5, 2) - 1 + $Months;
	return sprintf('%04d-%02d-01', floor($Total / 12), $Total % 12 + 1);
}

function ForecastMonthIndex($Date) {
	return (int) substr($Date, 0, 4) * 12 + (int) substr($Date, 5, 2) - 1;
}

function ForecastLastDayOfMonth($Date) {
	return date('Y-m-t', strtotime(ForecastMonthStart($Date)));
}

function ForecastIsDate($Date) {
	return is_string($Date) and preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/', $Date, $Parts) and checkdate((int) $Parts[2], (int) $Parts[3], (int) $Parts[1]);
}

/* Month of the last complete calendar month */
function ForecastLastCompleteMonth() {
	return ForecastAddMonths(date('Y-m-01'), -1);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ sales history */

/* The one definition of "sales": invoiced quantities (type 10) less credits (type 11), movements that are shown */
function ForecastSalesWhere() {
	return "stockmoves.type IN (10, 11) AND stockmoves.hidemovt = 0";
}

/* Range held in forecasthistory: array(from month, to month, extracted on, user) or null */
function ForecastHistoryRange() {
	$From = ForecastGetState('HistoryFrom');
	$To = ForecastGetState('HistoryTo');
	if ($From === null or $To === null) {
		return null;
	}
	return array('from' => $From, 'to' => $To, 'on' => ForecastGetState('HistoryExtractedOn'), 'user' => ForecastGetState('HistoryExtractedBy'));
}

/* Extract sales for the whole months From..To. Re-running a range replaces it. A range that neither overlaps nor
   touches the range already held replaces it (otherwise the gap would look like months without sales). */
function ForecastExtractHistory($From, $To, $UserID) {
	$From = ForecastMonthStart($From);
	$ToEnd = ForecastLastDayOfMonth($To);
	$Held = ForecastHistoryRange();

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	if ($Held !== null and ForecastMonthIndex($From) <= ForecastMonthIndex($Held['to']) + 1 and ForecastMonthIndex(ForecastMonthStart($To)) >= ForecastMonthIndex($Held['from']) - 1) {
		$NewFrom = min($From, $Held['from']);
		$NewTo = max(ForecastMonthStart($To), $Held['to']);
	} else {
		DB_query("DELETE FROM forecasthistory");
		$NewFrom = $From;
		$NewTo = ForecastMonthStart($To);
	}
	DB_query("DELETE FROM forecasthistory WHERE periodstart >= '" . $From . "' AND periodstart <= '" . $ToEnd . "'");
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO forecasthistory (stockid,
										loccode,
										debtortype,
										area,
										salesperson,
										periodstart,
										quantity)
			SELECT stockmoves.stockid,
					stockmoves.loccode,
					COALESCE(debtorsmaster.typeid, 0),
					COALESCE(custbranch.area, ''),
					COALESCE(custbranch.salesman, ''),
					DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01'),
					SUM(-stockmoves.qty)
			FROM stockmoves
			LEFT JOIN debtorsmaster ON debtorsmaster.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno
			LEFT JOIN custbranch ON custbranch.debtorno = stockmoves.debtorno
				AND custbranch.branchcode = stockmoves.branchcode
			WHERE " . ForecastSalesWhere() . "
				AND stockmoves.trandate >= '" . $From . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate <= '" . $ToEnd . "'
			GROUP BY stockmoves.stockid,
					stockmoves.loccode,
					COALESCE(debtorsmaster.typeid, 0),
					COALESCE(custbranch.area, ''),
					COALESCE(custbranch.salesman, ''),
					DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01')
			HAVING SUM(-stockmoves.qty) <> 0";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The sales history could not be extracted'));
	$Inserted = DB_affected_rows($Result);
	ForecastSetState('HistoryFrom', $NewFrom);
	ForecastSetState('HistoryTo', $NewTo);
	ForecastSetState('HistoryExtractedOn', date('Y-m-d H:i:s'));
	ForecastSetState('HistoryExtractedBy', $UserID);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return $Inserted;
}

function ForecastHistoryCounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stockid), COUNT(DISTINCT periodstart), COUNT(*) FROM forecasthistory");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return array('items' => (int) $MyRow[0], 'months' => (int) $MyRow[1], 'rows' => (int) $MyRow[2]);
}

/* Monthly history grouped by $GroupBy: stockid, category, debtortype, area or salesperson.
   $Filter keys: stockid, loccode (blank = all locations), categoryid, key. Returns array(group => array(month => qty)) */
function ForecastLoadHistory($GroupBy, $Filter = array()) {
	$Expressions = array('stockid' => 'forecasthistory.stockid',
						'category' => 'stockmaster.categoryid',
						'debtortype' => 'forecasthistory.debtortype',
						'area' => 'forecasthistory.area',
						'salesperson' => 'forecasthistory.salesperson');
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
	if ($Range === null) {
		return array();
	}
	$Where = "forecasthistory.periodstart >= '" . $Range['from'] . "' AND forecasthistory.periodstart <= '" . $Range['to'] . "'";
	if (isset($Filter['stockid'])) {
		$Where .= " AND forecasthistory.stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['stockid']) . "'";
	}
	if (isset($Filter['loccode']) and $Filter['loccode'] !== '') {
		$Where .= " AND forecasthistory.loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['loccode']) . "'";
	}
	if (isset($Filter['categoryid'])) {
		$Where .= " AND stockmaster.categoryid = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['categoryid']) . "'";
	}
	if (isset($Filter['key'])) {
		$Where .= " AND " . $Expressions[$GroupBy] . " = '" . DB_escape_string($Filter['key']) . "'";
	}
	$SQL = "SELECT " . $Expressions[$GroupBy] . " AS grp,
					forecasthistory.periodstart,
					SUM(forecasthistory.quantity) AS qty
			FROM forecasthistory
			INNER JOIN stockmaster ON stockmaster.stockid = forecasthistory.stockid
			WHERE " . $Where . "
			GROUP BY grp, forecasthistory.periodstart";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$History = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$History[$MyRow['grp']][$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['qty'];
	}
	return $History;
}

/* Turn sparse month => quantity into a series running from the first month with sales to the end of the history
   range. Months without sales inside it are zero. Months before the first sale are not history. Negative net
   months (more credits than sales) are taken as zero demand.
   Returns array('values' => array, 'start' => first month) */
function ForecastBuildSeries($ByMonth) {
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
	if ($Range === null or count($ByMonth) == 0) {
		return array('values' => array(), 'start' => null);
	}
	ksort($ByMonth);
	$Start = null;
	foreach ($ByMonth as $Month => $Qty) {
		if ($Qty != 0) {
			$Start = $Month;
			break;
		}
	}
	if ($Start === null) {
		return array('values' => array(), 'start' => null);
	}
	$Values = array();
	for ($Month = $Start; ForecastMonthIndex($Month) <= ForecastMonthIndex($Range['to']); $Month = ForecastAddMonths($Month, 1)) {
		$Values[] = isset($ByMonth[$Month]) ? max(0, $ByMonth[$Month]) : 0;
	}
	return array('values' => $Values, 'start' => $Start);
}

/* Actual sales by month for one item (blank location = all) read straight from the stock movements */
function ForecastActualsByMonth($StockID, $LocCode, $FromMonth, $ToMonth) {
	$SQL = "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stockmoves.trandate, '%Y-%m-01') AS periodstart,
					SUM(-stockmoves.qty) AS qty
			FROM stockmoves
			WHERE " . ForecastSalesWhere() . "
				AND stockmoves.stockid = '" . DB_escape_string($StockID) . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate >= '" . ForecastMonthStart($FromMonth) . "'
				AND stockmoves.trandate <= '" . ForecastLastDayOfMonth($ToMonth) . "'";
	if ($LocCode !== '') {
		$SQL .= " AND stockmoves.loccode = '" . DB_escape_string($LocCode) . "'";
	}
	$SQL .= " GROUP BY periodstart";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Actuals = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Actuals[$MyRow['periodstart']] = (float) $MyRow['qty'];
	}
	return $Actuals;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the methods */

/* Solve a small linear system by Gaussian elimination; false if singular */
function ForecastSolve($A, $B) {
	$N = count($B);
	for ($i = 0; $i < $N; $i++) {
		$Pivot = $i;
		for ($r = $i + 1; $r < $N; $r++) {
			if (abs($A[$r][$i]) > abs($A[$Pivot][$i])) {
				$Pivot = $r;
			}
		}
		if (abs($A[$Pivot][$i]) < 1e-12) {
			return false;
		}
		list($A[$i], $A[$Pivot]) = array($A[$Pivot], $A[$i]);
		list($B[$i], $B[$Pivot]) = array($B[$Pivot], $B[$i]);
		for ($r = $i + 1; $r < $N; $r++) {
			$Factor = $A[$r][$i] / $A[$i][$i];
			for ($c = $i; $c < $N; $c++) {
				$A[$r][$c] -= $Factor * $A[$i][$c];
			}
			$B[$r] -= $Factor * $B[$i];
		}
	}
	$X = array_fill(0, $N, 0);
	for ($i = $N - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
		$Sum = $B[$i];
		for ($c = $i + 1; $c < $N; $c++) {
			$Sum -= $A[$i][$c] * $X[$c];
		}
		$X[$i] = $Sum / $A[$i][$i];
	}
	return $X;
}

/* Forecast $Horizon months after the end of the series $y (oldest first) with method $MethodID.
   Returns array('ok' => bool, 'values' => forecast quantities (never negative), 'error' => reason) */
function ForecastRunMethod($MethodID, $y, $Horizon, $P) {
	$n = count($y);
	$Min = ForecastMinHistory($MethodID, $P);
	if ($n < $Min) {
		return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => sprintf(__('%s needs at least %s months of sales history but only %s are available'), ForecastMethodName($MethodID), $Min, $n));
	}
	$f = array();
	switch ($MethodID) {
		case 1: // last year x (1 + p/100)
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)] * (1 + $P['GrowthPercent'] / 100);
			}
			break;
		case 2: // growth of the last 12 months on the 12 before
			$Last = array_sum(array_slice($y, -12));
			$Prior = array_sum(array_slice($y, -24, 12));
			if ($Prior <= 0) {
				return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => __('There were no sales in the year before last so a growth percent cannot be calculated'));
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)] * $Last / $Prior;
			}
			break;
		case 3: // same month last year
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 12 + (($h - 1) % 12)];
			}
			break;
		case 4: // moving average of the last N periods, rolled forward on its own results
			$N = (int) $P['MAPeriods'];
			$Work = $y;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Value = array_sum(array_slice($Work, -$N)) / $N;
				$Work[] = $Value;
				$f[] = $Value;
			}
			break;
		case 5: // straight line through the last point and the point K periods before it
			$K = (int) $P['LinearBackPeriods'];
			$Slope = ($y[$n - 1] - $y[$n - 1 - $K]) / $K;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $y[$n - 1] + $Slope * $h;
			}
			break;
		case 6: // least squares line through all the history
			$SumX = $SumY = $SumXY = $SumXX = 0;
			for ($x = 0; $x < $n; $x++) {
				$SumX += $x;
				$SumY += $y[$x];
				$SumXY += $x * $y[$x];
				$SumXX += $x * $x;
			}
			$B = ($n * $SumXY - $SumX * $SumY) / ($n * $SumXX - $SumX * $SumX);
			$A = ($SumY - $B * $SumX) / $n;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $A + $B * ($n - 1 + $h);
			}
			break;
		case 7: // least squares parabola, x centred for numerical stability
			$Mean = ($n - 1) / 2;
			$S = array_fill(0, 5, 0);
			$T = array_fill(0, 3, 0);
			for ($x = 0; $x < $n; $x++) {
				$Xc = $x - $Mean;
				for ($p = 0; $p <= 4; $p++) {
					$S[$p] += pow($Xc, $p);
				}
				for ($p = 0; $p <= 2; $p++) {
					$T[$p] += pow($Xc, $p) * $y[$x];
				}
			}
			$Coefficients = ForecastSolve(array(array($S[0], $S[1], $S[2]), array($S[1], $S[2], $S[3]), array($S[2], $S[3], $S[4])), $T);
			if ($Coefficients === false) {
				return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => __('The second degree curve could not be fitted to the history'));
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Xc = $n - 1 + $h - $Mean;
				$f[] = $Coefficients[0] + $Coefficients[1] * $Xc + $Coefficients[2] * $Xc * $Xc;
			}
			break;
		case 8: // user weights per prior period, as entered
		case 9: // weighted moving average, weights scaled to add up to one
			$Weights = ForecastParseWeights($P[$MethodID == 8 ? 'FlexibleWeights' : 'WMAWeights']);
			if ($MethodID == 9) {
				$Total = array_sum($Weights);
				foreach ($Weights as $Key => $Weight) {
					$Weights[$Key] = $Weight / $Total;
				}
			}
			$Work = $y;
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$Value = 0;
				foreach ($Weights as $Lag => $Weight) {
					$Value += $Weight * $Work[count($Work) - 1 - $Lag];
				}
				$Work[] = $Value;
				$f[] = $Value;
			}
			break;
		case 10: // simple exponential smoothing
			$Alpha = (float) $P['Alpha'];
			$Level = $y[0];
			for ($t = 1; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Level = $Alpha * $y[$t] + (1 - $Alpha) * $Level;
			}
			$f = array_fill(0, $Horizon, $Level);
			break;
		case 11: // Holt double exponential smoothing
			$Alpha = (float) $P['Alpha'];
			$Beta = (float) $P['Beta'];
			$Level = $y[0];
			$Trend = $y[1] - $y[0];
			for ($t = 1; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Previous = $Level;
				$Level = $Alpha * $y[$t] + (1 - $Alpha) * ($Level + $Trend);
				$Trend = $Beta * ($Level - $Previous) + (1 - $Beta) * $Trend;
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $Level + $h * $Trend;
			}
			break;
		case 12: // Holt-Winters, additive seasonality
			$Alpha = (float) $P['Alpha'];
			$Beta = (float) $P['Beta'];
			$Gamma = (float) $P['Gamma'];
			$L = (int) $P['SeasonLength'];
			$Mean1 = array_sum(array_slice($y, 0, $L)) / $L;
			$Mean2 = array_sum(array_slice($y, $L, $L)) / $L;
			$Trend = ($Mean2 - $Mean1) / $L;
			$Level = $Mean1 + $Trend * ($L - 1) / 2; // level at the end of the first season
			$Season = array();
			for ($i = 0; $i < $L; $i++) {
				$Season[$i] = $y[$i] - ($Mean1 + $Trend * ($i - ($L - 1) / 2));
			}
			for ($t = $L; $t < $n; $t++) {
				$Previous = $Level;
				$Level = $Alpha * ($y[$t] - $Season[$t % $L]) + (1 - $Alpha) * ($Level + $Trend);
				$Trend = $Beta * ($Level - $Previous) + (1 - $Beta) * $Trend;
				$Season[$t % $L] = $Gamma * ($y[$t] - $Level) + (1 - $Gamma) * $Season[$t % $L];
			}
			for ($h = 1; $h <= $Horizon; $h++) {
				$f[] = $Level + $h * $Trend + $Season[($n - 1 + $h) % $L];
			}
			break;
	}
	foreach ($f as $Key => $Value) {
		if (!is_finite($Value)) {
			return array('ok' => false, 'values' => array(), 'error' => __('The method did not produce a usable result for this history'));
		}
		$f[$Key] = max(0, round($Value, 4));
	}
	return array('ok' => true, 'values' => $f, 'error' => '');
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ accuracy and best fit */

/* $Pairs = list of array(actual, forecast). MAD, POA (percent of accuracy), MSE, RMSE */
function ForecastStats($Pairs) {
	$Count = count($Pairs);
	$Actual = $Abs = $Sq = 0;
	foreach ($Pairs as $Pair) {
		$Error = $Pair[0] - $Pair[1];
		$Actual += $Pair[0];
		$Abs += abs($Error);
		$Sq += $Error * $Error;
	}
	if ($Count == 0) {
		return array('n' => 0, 'actual' => 0, 'abs' => 0, 'mad' => null, 'poa' => null, 'mse' => null, 'rmse' => null);
	}
	/* POA = 100 x (1 - total absolute error / total actual), not below zero. With no actual sales it is
	   100 only when nothing was forecast either. */
	if ($Actual > 0) {
		$POA = max(0, 100 * (1 - $Abs / $Actual));
	} else {
		$POA = $Abs == 0 ? 100 : 0;
	}
	return array('n' => $Count, 'actual' => $Actual, 'abs' => $Abs, 'mad' => $Abs / $Count, 'poa' => $POA, 'mse' => $Sq / $Count, 'rmse' => sqrt($Sq / $Count));
}

/* Hold out the last $Holdout months of $y, forecast them with every method that has enough history
   left and score them. Returns array(method id => array('ok', 'error', 'forecast', 'actual', 'stats')) */
function ForecastEvaluateMethods($y, $Holdout, $P) {
	$n = count($y);
	$Results = array();
	foreach (array_keys(ForecastMethods()) as $MethodID) {
		if ($Holdout >= $n) {
			$Results[$MethodID] = array('ok' => false, 'error' => __('Not enough history to hold months out'), 'forecast' => array(), 'actual' => array(), 'stats' => null);
			continue;
		}
		$Train = array_slice($y, 0, $n - $Holdout);
		$Actual = array_slice($y, $n - $Holdout);
		$Run = ForecastRunMethod($MethodID, $Train, $Holdout, $P);
		$Results[$MethodID] = array('ok' => $Run['ok'],
									'error' => $Run['error'],
									'forecast' => $Run['values'],
									'actual' => $Actual,
									'stats' => null);
		if ($Run['ok']) {
			$Pairs = array();
			foreach ($Actual as $Key => $Value) {
				$Pairs[] = array($Value, $Run['values'][$Key]);
			}
			$Results[$MethodID]['stats'] = ForecastStats($Pairs);
		}
	}
	return $Results;
}

/* Best fit for one series: method with the lowest total absolute error on the held out months (lowest id on a tie).
   Returns array(method id or 0, evaluation) */
function ForecastBestMethod($y, $Holdout, $P) {
	$Evaluation = ForecastEvaluateMethods($y, $Holdout, $P);
	$Best = 0;
	foreach ($Evaluation as $MethodID => $Result) {
		if ($Result['ok'] and ($Best == 0 or $Result['stats']['abs'] < $Evaluation[$Best]['stats']['abs'] - 1e-9)) {
			$Best = $MethodID;
		}
	}
	return array($Best, $Evaluation);
}

/* Best fit across many items: the method with the lowest total absolute error as a share of total actual sales
   on the held out months. A method must be applicable to at least half of the items that could be evaluated at all.
   $SeriesList = array(key => array of values). Returns array(best method id or 0, array(method id => array(items, abs, actual, score))) */
function ForecastBestMethodForSet($SeriesList, $Holdout, $P) {
	$Totals = array();
	foreach (array_keys(ForecastMethods()) as $MethodID) {
		$Totals[$MethodID] = array('items' => 0, 'abs' => 0, 'actual' => 0, 'score' => null);
	}
	$Evaluated = 0;
	foreach ($SeriesList as $y) {
		$Any = false;
		foreach (ForecastEvaluateMethods($y, $Holdout, $P) as $MethodID => $Result) {
			if ($Result['ok']) {
				$Any = true;
				$Totals[$MethodID]['items']++;
				$Totals[$MethodID]['abs'] += $Result['stats']['abs'];
				$Totals[$MethodID]['actual'] += $Result['stats']['actual'];
			}
		}
		if ($Any) {
			$Evaluated++;
		}
	}
	$Best = 0;
	foreach ($Totals as $MethodID => $Total) {
		if ($Total['items'] == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$Totals[$MethodID]['score'] = $Total['actual'] > 0 ? $Total['abs'] / $Total['actual'] : ($Total['abs'] > 0 ? PHP_INT_MAX : 0);
		if ($Total['items'] * 2 >= $Evaluated and ($Best == 0 or $Totals[$MethodID]['score'] < $Totals[$Best]['score'] - 1e-12)) {
			$Best = $MethodID;
		}
	}
	return array($Best, $Totals);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ storing forecasts */

/* Store a forecast for an item (blank location = all locations combined) and make it the active one; the
   previous active forecast is superseded but kept. Returns the new forecast id. */
function ForecastStoreItemForecast($StockID, $LocCode, $MethodID, $Parameters, $Series, $Values, $UserID) {
	$Range = ForecastHistoryRange();
	$StockID = DB_escape_string($StockID);
	$LocCode = DB_escape_string($LocCode);
	DB_Txn_Begin();
	DB_query("UPDATE forecasts SET active = NULL, supersededon = NOW()
				WHERE stockid = '" . $StockID . "' AND loccode = '" . $LocCode . "' AND active = 1");
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO forecasts (stockid,
									loccode,
									methodid,
									parameters,
									horizon,
									historyfrom,
									historyto,
									historymonths,
									generatedon,
									generatedby,
									active)
			VALUES ('" . $StockID . "',
					'" . $LocCode . "',
					" . (int) $MethodID . ",
					'" . DB_escape_string(json_encode(ForecastMethodParameters($MethodID, $Parameters))) . "',
					" . count($Values) . ",
					'" . $Range['from'] . "',
					'" . $Range['to'] . "',
					" . count($Series['values']) . ",
					NOW(),
					'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
					1)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The forecast could not be saved'));
	$ForecastID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('forecasts', 'forecastid');
	$Period = ForecastAddMonths($Range['to'], 1);
	foreach ($Values as $Value) {
		DB_query("INSERT INTO forecastdetails (forecastid, periodstart, calcqty) VALUES (" . (int) $ForecastID . ", '" . $Period . "', '" . $Value . "')");
		$Period = ForecastAddMonths($Period, 1);
	}
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return $ForecastID;
}
